name: Waymo Open Dataset — Perception Dataset
description: High-resolution autonomous driving perception dataset from Waymo featuring 2,030 20-second continuous driving segments (~390,000 frames at 10 Hz) recorded with 5 high-grade LiDAR sensors and 5 synchronized pinhole cameras across San Francisco, Mountain View, and Phoenix. The standardized core benchmark split comprises 1,150 segments (798 training, 202 validation, and 150 test), expanded in subsequent releases to 2,030 total segments for scalable 3D detection, tracking, and 2D/3D semantic and panoptic segmentation.
